metaDescription: Order custom PL eyewear for your team or event. Durable cases and retainers with your logo. Get a quote today.
introHtml: PL eyewear offers a practical way to keep safety glasses and sunglasses protected and accessible. Whether you need folding cases for trade show giveaways or cotton retainers for construction crews, these accessories keep your logo visible while extending the life of the eyewear. Choose from soft storage pouches or durable neoprene cases that fit standard frames.
